inherit: Use the parent's exact portfolio, accounting, scenarios, one/three-year episode endpoints, temporal partitions, purging, economic gates and bootstrap procedure. Only monthly_new_cash is primary; do not replace it with an existing-cash result.
priorExposure: add-score-v1, entry-percentile-knn-v1 and all seven equal-budget-entry-v1 rules have been examined on this history. This is another historical replication, never an untouched holdout. Do not tune this version after viewing its results.
hypothesis: Usually invest monthly money immediately; delay only if a fixed online predictor using already matured observations estimates a positive five-session waiting advantage.

model.featureDefinition: Target-weight CNY reference including 40% zero-interest strategic cash. At decision close t-1 use inclusive trailing MA200, running all-history peak, simple five/21 common-session returns, and sample standard deviation of the latest 21 simple reference returns (denominator 20, not annualized). All are fractions, not percentage points.
model.label: For hypothetical funding at common close s, compare immediate purchase at s with purchase at s+5, both liquidated at s+5. y_s=(1-sellFee)/(1+buyFee) * (1 - sum_j riskNormalizedWeight_j * CNY_adjusted_price_j(s+5)/CNY_adjusted_price_j(s)). Base cash rate is zero, buyFee=sellFee=0.001, normalized weights are 0.5/0.5. Positive y favors waiting, in units of risk budget.
model.alignment: Training feature for label y_s is observed at s-1. Prediction for funding t uses only features at t-1 and labels with s+5<=t-1. No current execution price t enters the predictor.
model.training: Expanding window of every eligible daily label; at least 756 fully matured labels with all five finite features. The fixed algorithm may learn from matured five-session labels during later partitions; it never learns from one-year account outcomes.
model.standardization: Fit feature mean and population standard deviation using the matured training pool only. A zero-variance feature maps to zero. Center y; intercept is unpenalized.
model.prediction: trainingMeanY + standardizedCurrentX dot beta; do not clamp, rescale to a score, or invert predictions
model.cashAndFeeStress: Freeze decisions from the base predictor for all stress scenarios. Apply each parent scenario's cash yield and fees to the account without refitting or choosing different decisions.

policy.decision: Each monthly deposit is decided once, using the preceding close. If predicted y>1e-12, its full 60% risk budget waits exactly five common sessions; otherwise it buys on arrival. Keep 40% strategic cash. Pending money cannot be borrowed or used to increase another deposit's allocation.
policy.whileWaiting: No re-prediction, early entry, extended deadline or selling. A lot still waiting at the fixed account terminal date remains cash.
policy.warmup: Eligible episode starts require an available prediction on their funding date. Exclude earlier starts from every benchmark equally; report the resulting shorter calendar coverage.
policy.researchIndicator: Predicted advantage of waiting five sessions, in basis points of the product budget; not a probability and not a 0-100 score. Never render this unvalidated indicator in production.

predictionDiagnostics.primaryDates: Distinct calendar-month funding decisions only; do not repeat the same decision because it occurs in multiple rolling account windows
predictionDiagnostics.referenceForecast: Mean y of exactly the same matured training pool
predictionDiagnostics.scope: These evaluate the short-horizon forecast only. Primary investment outcome is still the parent's paired one-year monthly-cash account result; short-term forecast accuracy cannot substitute for it.

confirmation.rule: One fixed candidate only. It must pass all parent economic gates in development/base/one-year before either later partition can confirm it. If development fails, later results are diagnostic only; no replacement model, feature, lambda, horizon or threshold is allowed in this version.
confirmation.laterPartitions: Pass the parent's economic gates against immediate separately in validation and replication. In each later base partition, mean and median paired wealth differences against fixed_delay5 and three_tranches must both be >=0. Retain positive mean and median improvement against immediate in each parent stress scenario. Parent positive descriptive interval lower bound and independent/tax requirements remain.
confirmation.integration: No automatic score or production integration. A historical pass still requires independent model/ledger/causality audit, production-equivalent dividend and personal-tax validation, and explicit scope/behavior for future re-evaluation. A failure remains research-only.
